messages:
mai: quick flag — during cypress-v0.9 int8 smoke I saw a weird token merge affecting zh + arabic RTL snippets. BLEU dropped ~3.2 on the small translate-merge test :eyes:
li: can you share a minimal repro and the tokenization? paste detok and raw tokens please :point_down:
mai: sure — below is the example input and tokenizer output from our staging tokenizer run:
```
input: "今天، ما رأيك؟\nI had lunch."  # mixed zh + arabic + en
tokens: ["▁今天", "،", "▁ما", "▁رأيك", "؟", "\n", "▁I", "▁had", "▁lunch", "."]
int8_output_tokens: ["▁今天", "،", "▁ما رأيك؟", "\n", "▁I", "▁had", "▁lunch", "."]
```
mai: notice how the arabic phrase got merged into one token in int8 path, but baseline fp16 keeps them separated — leads to punctuation glue and causes detokenized output: "今天، ما رأيك؟ I had lunch." vs expected spacing on edges for downstream detok tests
jonathan: hmm, that looks like a subtle token boundary shift in our fused kernel selection for bidi scripts when quant params are applied. likely during fused softmax/kernel reorder. did you see any ctx-length dependent behavior?
mai: only on samples with short zh prefix + rtl span. long arabic-only samples are fine. also saw a tiny increase in perplexity (~0.8) restricted to these cases.
ciara: adding QA note — this pattern breaks a handful of locale-specific unit tests (detok, sentence-split). I can attach failing test IDs if useful. I ran ablation toggling per-layer quant scale and the merge disappears if we force per-attn scaling to fp16 emulation.
li: can you run `tokenizer.debug_mode(True)` and collect raw byte offsets + join positions? also include the model config used for quant (symmetric/asymmetric, block size).
mai: will collect now and upload logs. repro script: `scripts/evals/locale_repro.sh --model cypress-v0.9 --quant int8 --case mixed-zh-ar` — expecting output in /tmp/cypress-repro-171900
jonathan: cc @eval-bot can you queue a small eval job across 5k synthetic mixedscript examples and diff tokenization counts vs fp16? tag with regression-qa and notify eng-ml channel when done. :white_check_mark:
eval-bot: queued job 4821 (cypress-v0.9, int8, mixedscript-5k). ETA ~12m. results will be posted to /artifacts/4821/locale-diff.json
ciara: thanks — I'll block the int8 rollout on dedicated pools until we confirm whether it's a tokenizer or runtime fusion issue. if it's quant kernel, we might need a hotfix kernel or a config opt-out for bidi merge. :warning:
mai: thanks everyone — will follow up with logs and the artifact link when eval finishes.
